notes: Deadly Plot (FDN), printed: 'Choose one - Destroy target creature or planeswalker. / Return target Zombie creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.' Mode 0 on a PLANESWALKER (the standard board has none): the opponent's planeswalker is a legal target and is destroyed; an artifact is not a legal target (the first cast is refused) and stays; the opponent's creature is untouched (one target, one destroyed).
